name: Sweet Potato Galette with Cream Cheese Pastry & Butter Pecan Ice Cream

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE GALETTE DOUGH: Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl.

Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter and cream cheese into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the ingredients by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup butter, unsalted
¾ (8 oz) block cream cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add cold water to the bowl and continue to mix with your hands to combine the dough.
Turn dough out onto a clean surface and pat into a 1-inch thick disk. Wrap the disk tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour.
FOR THE SWEET POTATOES: While the dough is chilling, preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, dry, peel, and trim sweet potatoes; slice crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Drizzle sweet potatoes with oil, season with salt, and toss to coat. Spread the slices out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp vegetable oil
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until sweet potatoes are tender-crisp, about 15 minutes (the sweet potatoes will continue to cook in the galette). Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature.
TO ASSEMBLE AND BAKE THE GALETTE: Once the dough has chilled, turn the oven back on to 425°F. Line another large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place sugar and spices in a small bowl. Stir to combine the spiced sugar and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup granulated sugar
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
⅛ tsp clove, ground
⅛ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle a small amount of flour over a flat work surface (start with 1 tablespoon and add more as needed). Unwrap the dough and place on top of the floured work surface; sprinkle dough with a little more flour.
Using a rolling pin, work the dough into a circle that is 14-inches in diameter (it should be between ⅛ to ¼-inch thick). Carefully transfer the dough to the baking sheet.

Place half of the sweet potato slices in the center of the dough, arranging them in a single layer (make sure to leave a 2 ½ to 3-inch border of dough around the sweet potatoes). Sprinkle half of the spiced sugar over the sweet potatoes. Create a second layer using the rest of the sweet potatoes, then sprinkle with remaining spiced sugar.
Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over the top of the sweet potatoes.
Gently fold crust edges up toward the center, overlapping folds slightly, and pinch each fold to enclose the sweet potatoes. Sprinkle the edges with additional sugar.

Place galette in the oven and bake, rotating the baking sheet halfway through, until the pastry is golden brown and cooked through, 25-30 minutes (if the top of the crust is browning too quickly, tent a piece of aluminum foil over the top). Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
TO SERVE: Cut the galette into wedges. Divide galette and ice cream between plates and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 24 fl oz butter pecan ice cream
